reviewer: Codex primary final critical reading; selected separate-reader findings retained in evidence/reviews. No human/Claude acceptance claimed.

clarity.evidence: A customer asking for $60 with $20/$50 notes explains why the greedy note plan can fail.

scope.evidence: Completed ATM session, bank hold, note reservation, dispensing and settlement flow; the fake adapters are explicit.

contracts.evidence: Bank reservation, dispenser attempt and session have separate identities and states; an uncertain physical outcome is retained.

correctness.evidence: AtmChecks passes 2389 checks including exact bounded note allocation and atomic bank holds; use integer minor units.

failure_handling.evidence: Bank uncertainty, device uncertainty and settlement uncertainty are handled separately; partial cash is reconciled and quarantined before further dispensing.

tradeoffs.evidence: Dynamic programming versus greedy, reversible reservation versus physical delivery, and crash recovery boundaries are explained.

visual_learning.evidence: atm-traces.json comes from AtmDemo and lets the learner step through five bank/cash outcomes with text fallback.

code.evidence: examples/learning-java/src/kb/atm; full copyable source/download parity and exact excerpts checked by check_review_lot.py; actual runtime output in lot-command-output.json and lot-runtime.json.

rendering.evidence: LLD-5-browser.json: article and walkthrough in light/dark at 1280/390px; theme controls, navigation, no missing images/page-wide overflow, table contrast >=4.5. Per-topic assets resolve.

limits: Local mechanism and fixture checks do not establish remote-provider behavior, distributed durability/failover, production throughput or model quality. Scope-specific boundaries are explicit in the answer.
